name: complaint-file
title: Complaint file
for_each: select id, ref from complaints order by ref

sections.title: The complaint
sections.sql: select ref, brand, complainant, complainant_type, received_on as received, channel, complaint_type as type, product, representative, summary, owner, status from complaint_register where id = $1

sections.title: Deadlines and what was sent
sections.sql: select d.acknowledge_by, d.acknowledged_on, d.respond_by, d.delay_notice_on, d.resolved_on, d.response_on, d.rule from complaint_deadlines d where d.id = $1

sections.title: Issues
sections.sql: select issue from complaint_issues where complaint_id = $1 order by issue

sections.title: Outcomes and remedies
sections.sql: select outcome, to_char(remedy_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as remedy from complaint_outcomes where complaint_id = $1 order by outcome

sections.title: Contact log
sections.sql: select on_date as date, case direction when 'in' then 'from complainant' else 'to complainant' end as direction, method, note, by_whom as by from contacts where complaint_id = $1 order by on_date, created_at

sections.title: Record history
sections.sql: select created_at as at, action, actor from activity where entity_id = $1::text order by created_at, id
sections.note: The file AFCA or FSCL asks for when a complaint is escalated. Keep it with the complaint.

name: board-pack
title: Complaints report to the board
for_each: select code as id, code from reporting_periods order by starts_on

sections.title: The period
sections.sql: select code, starts_on, ends_on, due_on as asic_due, submitted_on as lodged, submission_ref as receipt from reporting_periods where code = $1

sections.title: Complaints by brand
sections.sql: select brand, count(*) as complaints, count(*) filter (where status = 'open') as still_open, count(*) filter (where escalated_on is not null) as to_scheme, round(avg(days_to_close)) as avg_days_to_close from idr_period_rows where period = $1 group by brand order by brand

sections.title: Most common issues
sections.sql: select i.issue, count(*) as complaints from idr_period_rows r join complaint_issues i on i.complaint_id = r.id where r.period = $1 group by i.issue order by complaints desc, i.issue limit 8

sections.title: Systemic issues
sections.sql: select code, title, status, raised_on, reported_to, complaints from systemic_register where $1::text is not null order by status, raised_on
sections.note: RG 271 expects complaints data and systemic issues to reach senior management and the board.

name: systemic-issue
title: Systemic issue report
for_each: select id, code from systemic_issues order by code

sections.title: The issue
sections.sql: select code, title, description, owner, status, raised_on, reported_to, reported_on, root_cause from systemic_issues where id = $1

sections.title: Complaints linked to it
sections.sql: select r.ref, r.brand, r.received_on, r.product, r.status, to_char(coalesce(r.remedy_cents, 0) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') as remedy from complaint_register r join complaints c on c.id = r.id where c.systemic_issue_id = $1 order by r.received_on
